Subject: BrightLayer vendor governance kickoff — scheduling & agenda

Hi Sara,

Thanks for agreeing to begin onboarding BrightLayer. We'd like to run a 45-minute kickoff this week to align on procurement steps (vendor setup, PO cadence, onboarding forms), stakeholders, and a mutual action plan (MAP) toward go-live.

Proposed times (PST):
- Wed Aug 18, 10:00–10:45
- Wed Aug 18, 15:00–15:45
- Thu Aug 19, 09:00–09:45

High-level agenda (draft):
1) Introductions & roles (5m)
2) Vendor setup checklist + required docs (10m)
3) PO & billing flow, invoicing cadence (10m)
4) MAP: milestones, owners, timeline to production (10m)
5) Success criteria & next steps (10m)

Can you confirm which time works and who from BrightLayer should join? If you prefer, send a calendar invite and we'll add our stakeholders. I've attached the vendor onboarding form we usually request — if BrightLayer can prefill, that'll speed the PO.

Thanks,

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference

I'll send a calendar invite in a bit and attach our vendor W-9 and procurement contact details.

Great call, everyone — thanks for the time.

Summary / agreed items (short):
- Onboarding docs: BrightLayer to return completed onboarding form + W-9 + DPA redlines by Mon Aug 23.
- PO terms: BrightLayer prefers net-30; Redwood procurement will check whether finance can accept net-30 for this partner. Marissa to confirm by Aug 24.
- MAP: Owners updated in the shared MAP; BrightLayer to add finance/legal contacts in column B by EOD Aug 20.
- Test cadence: 2-week smoke test post-contract signature; target production on or before Sep 15.
- Success criteria: 99th pctile latency within SLA for staged traffic + no PII beyond hashed IDs in test payloads.

Next steps:
- Marissa: confirm PO cadence with Finance (due 2026-08-24)
- Sara/Daniel: return docs + DPA feedback (due 2026-08-23)
- Rishi: introduce product contact for integration (by 2026-08-20)

If anyone wants to add to these notes, reply-all. I'll keep an updated MAP on the shared Drive link.

Grace O'Connor
